title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Home Delivery Tariff by Program
content:
Ridgeline Special Order Services program figures for home delivery: whether the program offers home delivery, the program's home delivery fee, its free-delivery threshold, the notice for moving a delivery free, the fee for a later move and the fee for a failed delivery.

## Terms of the tariff

- **Home delivery offered** — whether home delivery is offered for the program.
- **Home delivery fee** — the program's home delivery charge, in US dollars.
- **Free-delivery threshold** — the order total at or above which home delivery is free, in US dollars; 0.00 means the program has no free-delivery threshold.
- **Reschedule notice** — hours before the delivery window by which a delivery may be moved free.
- **Late reschedule fee** — the fee for moving a delivery with less notice, in US dollars.
- **Failed delivery fee** — the fee when a delivery cannot be completed because no one is at the address, in US dollars.

## Tariff

| Program | Home delivery offered | Home delivery fee (USD) | Free-delivery threshold (USD) | Reschedule notice (hours) | Late reschedule fee (USD) | Failed delivery fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | yes | 8.99 | 45.00 | 24 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | yes | 79.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 0.00 | 45.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | yes | 99.00 | 0.00 | 48 | 49.00 | 99.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | yes | 149.00 | 0.00 | 48 | 79.00 | 149.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 48 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Reading the tariff

- Fabricated Countertops does not offer home delivery.
- Catalog Merchandise is the only program with a free-delivery threshold (45.00); every other program shows 0.00, meaning no threshold.
- Made-to-Measure Window Coverings has a home delivery fee of 0.00.
- Windows and Exterior Doors and Semi-Custom Cabinetry require 48 hours' notice to move a delivery free; the other programs require 24 hours.
